key_points: Starbucks closing 250 stores signals strategic restructuring but Baird cut price target on the news
Company raised guidance despite closures, suggesting confidence in remaining portfolio profitability
Multiple analysts raised price targets ahead of Q2 earnings, indicating optimism on turnaround progress
Reported exploration of Japan stake sale could unlock value and fund global growth initiatives
Pre-market trading slightly positive (+0.42%) suggests market digesting mixed signals
